name: Cable Incline Straight-Arm Pulldown
steps: Set an adjustable bench to a moderate incline facing a high pulley with a bar attached.
Lie chest down on the pad with feet braced and grip the bar overhand with arms extended overhead.
Keep your elbows softly bent as you sweep the bar down in an arc toward your hips.
Guide the bar back up under control until your arms extend in line with your torso.
tips: Keep your chest against the pad as your arms sweep down.
Hold a fixed slight bend in your elbows so your lats drive the motion rather than your triceps.
